title: Package entry accepting a pre-release band
description: packages.config declares an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
limitation: It matches an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
